coaching.headline: A losing 8.5-min invade snowballed Sparrow and Serath, and the bad trades never stopped.
coaching.team: Three lanes were favored, but the game was lost early in our own jungle: the 8.5 fight (0-3) went down with our offlane alive and never joining — softened only by Mini Prime taken in the same window, so read it as a trade — and it still handed Sparrow and Serath a lead they never gave back; the 11.7 Mini Prime fight (1-4) buried it. From there it was losing team fights — the 20.2 Fangtooth (1-3), the 26.6 Primal Fangtooth (2-4) — and bad trades deep in our jungle (13.7, 22.6, 29.6). Towers ended 2 to their 12 as Sparrow ran to 14/5. The lesson: don't start the 8.5 fight a man short, and after the 11.7 wipe stop feeding the same carries on the same ground.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Losing the 8.5-min jungle invade (0-3) and the 11.7 Mini Prime fight (1-4) early, which fed Sparrow and Serath a lead that turned every later fight into a loss.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Phase died 8 times, starting with the 8.5 jungle loss and through every team wipe after. As the frontline support, Mr_Meat31's reads set the fights, and these were almost all unwinnable from the start. When the team is collapsing in its own jungle at 8.5, the call is to back off, not commit.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Kira led the team in damage (30k) and got the bright spot — a 2-0 at their Mini Prime at 18.1, though the macro notes they traded that fight for Mini Prime across the map. But 8 deaths came from being dragged into the lost fights (11.7, 20.2, 26.6). Goldilocks324 was the favored carry; protect that by not being in the front of fights the team is already losing.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Greystone — only 3 deaths, the steadiest US line, and Cuban Noobster won the 23.3 fight (4-2). Greystone carried no magic resist into a 3-magical comp per the flag. The discipline was right; the team needed more of it. Keep being the one who doesn't over-commit into their fed carries.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Gadget went 1/7 — 7 deaths into a game decided early, including solo catches at 9.1 and 22.1. At 20.2 Willy Guggenheim was ahead in lane and absent from the fight, and the 22.6 fight opened 4v5 29 seconds after Willy fell. A ranged mid's damage should come from the back; poke and reposition, don't trade bodies.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Khaimera was the favored jungle, but it started with the 8.5 loss in our own jungle (0-3) — a 5v5 our offlane never joined, so the team fought it a man short. That's the jungler's fight to read; 8 deaths followed across the team wipes. Next time that fight is going wrong, give up the camp and reset rather than feeding two enemy carries.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Iggy & Scorch Inferno (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Narbash. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 2 items of it.
Dive threat on our backline: Serath. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Gadget Security Gate (root 1s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.winCondition: buff a hyper-carry through the Link and Hyperflux for a teamfight

ourKits.playAgainst: kill the linked carry, not Phase; break the link timing

ourKits.winCondition: stack Vengeance and shred with the channeled Purge
ourKits.playWith: peel so she can channel Purge safely
ourKits.playAgainst: interrupt/CC her during Purge; punish her short dash cooldown

ourKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
ourKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
ourKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
ourKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal

ourKits.combo: Security Gate root → Sticky Mine → Tesla Dome zone ult

ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.playAgainst: peel the backline — deny the first kill and her resets dry up

enemyKits.winCondition: layer fire zones on a choke/objective and burn the team
enemyKits.playWith: CC that holds enemies in his fire

enemyKits.combo: Thunk stun → March! speed → Song heal aura → Crash Bang Boom! AoE slow ult

enemyKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult

enemyKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
